title: StitchScope Vision Proposal
description: The structured shape a vision-model stitch-pattern proposal must conform to before StitchScope's reconstruction engine will validate it. engine/schema.py enforces these same rules in plain Python.

stitch_family.description: Human-readable name for the guessed stitch pattern, e.g. 'filet mesh'.

confidence.description: The model's own confidence in this proposal, 0-1. Metadata about the guess, not validated for correctness.

uncertain_fields.description: Names of fields the model is unsure about, e.g. 'stitch_count'. Empty list means confident in everything proposed.

setup.description: The one-time steps worked before the repeat starts. Can be empty.

repeat.description: The unit that repeats across the rest of the row. Never empty.

repeat_count.description: How many times the proposal claims the repeat is worked. The engine checks this claim against stitches actually available -- it is not free to adjust it to make the row fit.

status: Superseded by proposal_schema_v2.json on 2026-09-04 -- v1 assumed one stitch pattern per photo; the real product needs to detect 2-3 distinct stitch regions in a single garment photo. Kept for history, not used by engine/schema.py anymore.
